THE MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS DENIED BECAUSE DEFENDANT HAS NOT CARRIED THE BURDEN OF SHOWING PLAINTIFF CANNOT PROVE ANY DAMAGES UNDER THE CONTRACT WHICH DOES NOT EXCLUDE DIRECT DAMAGES, AND DEFENDANT DID NOT SHOW PLAINTIFF HAS NOT SUFFERED ANY DAMAGES, AND, IN ANY EVENT, THE LACK OF CONTRACT DAMAGES WOULD NOT NECESSARILY MEAN PLAINTIFF SUFFERED NO DAMAGES ON HIS OTHER CAUSES OF ACTION. THE MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS DENIED BECAUSE DEFENDANT DID NOT COMPLY WITH C R C 3.1350(B) IN THAT THE ISSUES IDENTIFIED IN THE SEPARATE STATEMENT NOT ONLY ARE NOT IDENTICAL TO THOSE IDENTIFIED IN THE NOTICE OF MOTION BUT DO NOT REMOTELY CORRESPOND. IN ANY EVENT, DEFENDANT DID NOT CARRY THE BURDEN AS TO ANY MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION ISSUE. PREVAILING PARTY TO PREPARE ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189
